sources.title: 《續日本紀》卷二十天平寶字元年十一月癸未敕
sources.provider: 久遠の絆 digital received transcription
sources.quality_notes: Read full surrounding decree: Yin-Yang students four named books, astronomy and calendrical students distinct lists, appointment and teacher remuneration context. 757 event not surviving decree original, exact first import or natal method proof.

sources.title: 筑波大學2023企畫展第34、35號《日本國見在書目錄》
sources.quality_notes: Exhibit estimates circa 891 compilation; late-Heian Muroji former holding now Imperial Household collection; 1851 postscript and 1884 Gu Yi Cong Shu are later witnesses. Does not independently show Wuxing Dayi entry.

sources.title: 識典《日本國見在書目錄》NDL2540620 五行家條
sources.quality_notes: Displayed Wuxing-jia passage contains 五行大義一 amid severely corrupted OCR. Exact glyph, numeral, unit and original folio unverified; quarantine numeral and do not infer one-juan recension.

sources.title: 日本文化廳《五行大義卷第五》指定編號01330
sources.quality_notes: One book, owner Sanboin, Kamakura period, collation postscript Hōji 2 ninth month middle ten days, important cultural property designation 1949-05-30. Not original leaf review.

sources.title: 和歌山縣文化財《五行大義卷第五》
sources.quality_notes: Same Sanboin object deposited Koyasan Reihokan; 64 leaves, seven lines per half-page, red collation note, estimated early Kamakura copying. Not separate physical witness; copying date not precisely 1248.

sources.title: 《五行大義》高木利太1932年6月影印書目
sources.quality_notes: Indexed catalogue identifies facsimile of Koyasan Sanboin manuscript, Kyoto University holding. Full detail page access incomplete; no facsimile leaves or digest acquired.
